A patch for ZFS: a replica no longer needs a backup next to it.

## ✨ Added

- **Replica only, no backup.** The replica card of a ZFS entry has a switch that turns off the own folder and the off-site storage locations of the ZFS section. A run then sends only the replica and writes no restic backup. It holds for every ZFS entry, and switching it off brings the own folder back. ([#356](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/356))

## ⚡ Improved

- **The replica hint says how to get a replica without a backup.** Before, the way was only visible in the storage graph, where the ZFS lines have to be switched off one by one. ([#356](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/356))

## 🌐 Translations

- **The new texts in all 42 languages.**
